description: Aprovechamientos Hidroeléctricos: Restitución is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wms.mapama.gob.es. The data set called Hydroelectric Uses of the Ministry for the Ecological Transition and the Demographic Challenge includes cartographic and alphanumeric information of the Hydroelectric Power Plants, their Tomas and their associated Restitution. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Hydroelectric exploitations: Restitution" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2011-06-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
